BiblicalUsage: Lᵉʼummîym means Leum mim, an Arabian, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Genesis 25:3, "and Leummim.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a single name in a genealogy counts — Leummim is named once, and God kept the record.
